verdicts.reason: A is unusable. The headline, subcopy and CTA label are shrunk to microscopic text in a sea of dead space. The plan cards are squeezed into narrow pill shapes with unreadable labels, and the fine print runs as one tiny line across the middle. B has a strong headline, an obvious orange CTA and an intact logo, but it has its own problems: the price cards are tiny with illegible plan labels, the plan order is shuffled (6, 80, 48, so Yearly is no longer in the middle), and the legal text is about the same size as the subcopy and crammed against the right edge with an orphaned 'person.'
